## Rule

_Not fully decoded. Algorithm uses reflection-based shape detection: extracts non-ch2 channels from 10×10 crop, finds "shape" mask and "main color", then computes 9 axis-aligned reflections using permutation MatMuls, sums them to get fg/bg masks, then colors and pads back to 30×30._

## Algorithm sketch

185 nodes, opset 9. Key:
1. `Slice(input, [0:10,0:10], axes=[2,3]) → inp10 [1,10,10,10]`
2. `two_mask = Slice(inp10, ch2)`; `ch1 = Slice(inp10, ch1)`; `ch3_9 = Slice(inp10, ch3:10)`
3. `ch_no2 = Concat(ch1, ch3_9)` [1,8,10,10]; `shape_mask = ReduceMax(ch_no2, axis=1)` → [1,1,10,10]
4. `main_color_ch_no2 = ReduceMax(ch_no2, axes=[2,3])` → [1,8,1,1]; then Slice → mc_ch1, mc_ch3_9
5. Extract 10 column/row slices from shape_mask and two_mask → shape_col_i, two_col_i, shape_row_i, two_row_i [1,1,10,1] / [1,1,1,10]
6. For i in 0..8: `axis_horiz_i = ReduceMax(shape_col_i × two_col_{i+1}) + ReduceMax(two_col_i × shape_col_{i+1})`; similar for vertical
7. For i in 0..8: `refl_h_i = MatMul(shape_mask, P_i) × axis_horiz_i`; `refl_v_i = MatMul(P_i, shape_mask) × axis_vert_i` (P_i are anti-diagonal permutation matrices)
8. `fg_raw2 = Sum(shape_mask, two_mask, refl_h_0..8, refl_v_0..8)` → Relu → fg_mask
9. `bg_mask = Relu(1 - fg_mask)`; output = `Pad(Mul(main_color, fg_mask) + Mul(ch3_onehot, bg_mask))`

- shape_mask, two_mask, fg_raw2, fg_mask, bg_raw, bg_mask: 6×400B = 2400B
